_about: Public-domain Thomas Brett (1667-1744), nonjuring bishop and liturgist of the Usager party, for the Word Hoard: A Collection of the Principal Liturgies (London, 1838), An Account of Church Government (1710), The Independency of the Church upon the State (1717), The Divine Right of Episcopacy (1718) and A Chronological Essay on the Sacred History (1729), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

Paul's Church-yard, 1718)
